supersedes: maky.commerce2.exact-locale-contract/1 (M commit 3b7b145): Austria read DE and Canada read EN; a product's seoTitle fell back to the translated name and its slug to the base slug. Both are gone in v2.
verifiedBy: src/lib/saleor/exact-locale.contract.test.ts — the market matrix below is compared with the code, and every product field is deleted one at a time and the resolver's verdict compared with this file
rule: A foreign market renders only an exact translation in its own languageCode. Nothing falls back to the Slovak base row, nothing falls back from a regional code to the code it was seeded from, and nothing falls back from one translated field to another: a missing required field means the resource does not exist in that market.

sk.reads: the SK base row (Product.name, .slug, …), never a translation

DE_AT.rule: Seeded ONCE from the complete five-field DE record, with origin and target kept in CFM's own evidence. Afterwards an independent record: a later DE export never overwrites a DE_AT field that differs from its seed. The storefront reads DE_AT alone — an Austrian page never shows the DE row.

EN_CA.rule: Seeded ONCE from the complete five-field EN record, same evidence and override rules as DE_AT. The storefront reads EN_CA alone — a Canadian page never shows the EN row.

notTargets.SK: the base row; Slovakia is never a translation
notTargets.EN_US: the United States reads EN — there is no EN_US batch, and a query for it finds no row

product.read: translation(languageCode) on the product, its category, and every attribute and attribute value in the payload

slug.route: /{market}/{slug} — the translated slug IS the product's public URL in that market
slug.lookup: product(slug, channel) as a base slug first, then product(slug, channel, slugLanguageCode: <the market's languageCode>)
slug.unique: one product per slug within one languageCode, or the translated lookup cannot answer

alsoRequired: category.translation.name — when the product has a category
attribute.translation.name — for every attribute the payload carries (product, variant selection and non-selection)
value.translation.name — for every value of those attributes
product.description: EditorJS JSON string, as the base row
product.onMissing: the product does not exist in that market: PDP not-found (soft-404 under PPR), dropped from listings, search and vehicle-page offers, no hreflang counterpart, no market-switcher target

category.read: translation(languageCode) on the category page query

optionalTranslationFields.slug: not used for routing — the storefront routes the segment in config/category-routes.ts and asks Saleor by base slug

category.onMissing: the category page is not-found in that market; a product in that category is also refused (see product.alsoRequired)

collection.read: translation(languageCode) on the collection page query

optionalTranslationFields.slug: falls back to the base slug

collection.onMissing: the collection page is not-found in that market

menuItem.read: translation(languageCode) on the item and on what it links to
alsoRequired: category.translation.name — when the item links a category
collection.translation.name — when the item links a collection
page.translation.title — when the item links a page
menuItem.onMissing: the item is hidden in that market

dependenciesOfARegionalCode: Before a market reading DE_AT or EN_CA can show a product, the same code must carry: the product's five fields, the translation of its category (stresne-nosice and nordrive-stresne-nosice for the COMMERCE-2 cohort; four fields each for the category page) and every attribute/value the product payload carries. Measured 2026-09-18 on Product:9164: no visible attributes, and the navbar/footer menus are empty — so for the cohort the dependencies are the two categories.
price: Per channel from the exact variant's pricing in that channel. Never converted, never borrowed from another channel: AT reads DE_AT and DE reads DE, and each keeps its own channel price.

readback.checks: the channel belongs to this storefront; languageCode is one of targetLanguageCodes AND the one this contract names for that channel; product and category pass the resolver; the variant's currency is the channel's
readback.privacy: No tokens, no customer data, no admin-only fields. Only what the anonymous storefront query returns once a listing is public.
